name: Build: screen-space reflections with sky fallback, quality levels and editor controls
body: Plan. (1) The lit and sky pipelines get a second colour target, a small surface buffer (RGBA8: octahedral normal, roughness, reflectance), so a post pass knows which pixels are glossy and which way they face. Its store op is DONT_CARE when reflections are off. (2) A full-screen pass (ssr.frag) reads depth, the surface buffer and the HDR scene, marches a ray in screen space for glossy pixels only (early out otherwise), and writes scene plus reflection into a second HDR texture that bloom and the composite then read, so reflected lamps bloom. Where the ray misses or leaves the screen it keeps the sky reflection the lit shader already added; a fade towards the screen's edges and with roughness and distance. (3) PostSettings gets reflection settings; SetQuality: low off, medium on at 24 steps, high 48 steps with a refinement; Nyx SetScreenSpaceReflections(enabled, intensity, maxDistance); env LANTERN_SSR=0|1; editor Graphics tab checkbox. (4) Skinned characters use the same fragment shader, so they land in the surface buffer and the depth buffer and appear in reflections. (5) Docs: docs/screen-space-reflections.md, wet-surfaces.md, quality-settings.md, graphics-effects.md, renderer.md; decisions from D-152. (6) Tests, before/after screenshots, MSL output checked as far as the cloud can.
